commit_C_describes: v4.11.4-2-ge1f36a7316 (parent of the temp-upload fix f7500b1b19)

included_vulns.name: Unauthenticated temporary file upload on auth pages
included_vulns.open_at_C_proof: At C the auth pages do not use the upload-restriction trait; a Livewire `_startUpload`/`_finishUpload` call on the login component with a non-file target path is accepted (dispatches a signed upload URL / returns 200) instead of being refused with 403. Reproduced in-container.
included_vulns.entry_point: Livewire call `_startUpload` / `_finishUpload` on the unauthenticated login component

included_vulns.name: Password-validity disclosure for accounts denied panel access
included_vulns.open_at_C_proof: At C `authenticate()` presents the multi-factor challenge before the panel-access check. For a user with MFA enabled who is denied access to the panel, a correct password sets the challenge state while a wrong password returns the generic error. Reproduced: challenge-on-correct=true, challenge-on-wrong=false.
included_vulns.entry_point: HTTP/Livewire login `authenticate` on a panel the account cannot access

included_vulns.name: Authenticator code usable after a newer code (replay / non-invalidation)
included_vulns.open_at_C_proof: At C the used-code cache key is md5(secret.code), so each code has its own marker. After accepting the current code, an earlier in-window code is still accepted. Reproduced: verifyCode(current)=true then verifyCode(earlier)=true on vulnerable code (must be false after fix).
included_vulns.entry_point: HTTP/Livewire multi-factor challenge `authenticate`; code verification via the provider's public verifyCode API

included_vulns.name: Multi-factor management action does not require password reauthentication
included_vulns.open_at_C_proof: At C the 'disable app authentication' action has no password field and succeeds with only a valid one-time code. Reproduced: an authenticated session disabled MFA (secret cleared) without supplying the password.

dropped_vulns.reason: The 'MFA bypass when recovery codes enabled' change is a usability-oriented fix (allowing an OTP after toggling recovery mode); empirically it is not a deterministic authentication bypass through the login form — the observed outcome is cache/rate-limit-state dependent and flaky, so it was dropped per BUILDER 'drop any you cannot reproduce'.
Recovery-code reuse was fixed upstream in 4.3.1, long before C (~4.11.4); it is already closed at C, so not co-present with this cluster.
Concurrent recovery-code reuse (race condition) fixed in 4.11.5 and inherently timing/flaky to reproduce offline; dropped.
Timing-based user enumeration; a timing side-channel is inherently flaky to assert deterministically, and it is fixed in 4.11.5; dropped.

verified.exploit_entry_point: All four exploited through the framework's own Livewire/HTTP test harness (Orchestra Testbench + Livewire::test), driving the real login component, multi-factor challenge form, unauthenticated temporary-upload endpoints, and the profile-security disable action — not internal helpers.
variants: CWE-862: _startUpload on the login component with a non-file path -> blocked (403) after fix; _finishUpload on the login component with a non-file path -> blocked after fix
CWE-204: correct password on a denied panel no longer advances to the challenge; correct and incorrect password produce identical outcome

CWE-294: an earlier in-window code is rejected after a newer code is accepted (provider API); a captured earlier code cannot complete a fresh login after the user used a newer one (full login+challenge flow)
CWE-306: disabling MFA with no password is rejected; disabling MFA with an incorrect password is rejected
verified.project_tests_run: The framework's own auth tests (tests/src/Panels/Auth/*) exist at C and are Pest-based; the verifier does not run /app's own tests (untrusted) but runs independent PHPUnit copies under /tests that extend the framework's Testbench TestCase. Confirmed in-container: at C all 8 security tests FAIL and all 7 functional PASS; after the combined upstream source fix all 15 PASS.

patch_checks.note: 2026-10-16: reference fix, but the login upload guard dereferences a missing field (Error -> HTTP 500) instead of refusing; passed the old 'any throwable' upload test
2026-10-16: reference fix, but the password check crashes on a missing password (TypeError -> Livewire 419) instead of refusing; passed the old catch-all reauth test

notes: PHP/Laravel (Filament monorepo) at v4.11.4+2. PHP 8.4 required (composer.lock pins symfony 8.1 -> php >=8.4.1). Offline: composer installs at build; tests run on in-memory SQLite via Orchestra Testbench + Livewire, no services. Verifier runs in shared mode and drives the real auth entry points. Four co-present favoured auth/authz vulns fixed together; the oracle is the real upstream source fixes (temp-upload trait + panel-access check + per-secret code-reuse key + password reauthentication on the disable action).
